auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN ImmuneMarkers AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.CRP != 'negative'
  AND T1.`First Date` IS NULL

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN ImmuneMarkers AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T3."CRP" IN ('+','2+','3+','4+') AND T2."Examination Date" IS NULL
